mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, potentiating glipizide's hypoglycemic effects and increasing risk of severe hypoglycemia; additive CNS effects and potential sympathomimetic crisis if dietary tyramine or other agents are involved.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution; if necessary, reduce glipizide dose significantly and implement intensive glucose monitoring; consider alternative antidiabetic or antidepressant agents.
